studio.text: ArrrStudio builds Roblox game kits, tools for creators and custom websites. Every release arrives whole — clean code, curated UI and install docs — so you install it, then publish.

origin.label: Origin
origin.title: From an in-game name to a studio name.
story: “Arrr” is the name Sigit Hardianto plays under. There was never a plan to start a studio — the systems were built for his own Roblox games.
Then other creators needed them too. One kit became two, then a catalog. The in-game name came along as it was, and ArrrStudio was born.
origin.quote: Never meant to make it. Made it anyway.
origin.bio: An enterprise web background — Vue.js, .NET, Laravel — carried into Roblox: modular architecture, safe data, and UI treated as a product.

items.title: Ready to ship
items.text: Kits ship as whole, tested systems — wired into the DataStore, group ranks, gamepasses and leaderstats you already run. Not loose scripts to assemble yourself.

items.title: Curated
items.text: UI built on design tokens, responsive on PC and phone, never a template. Every project gets its own visual identity.

items.title: Built to last
items.text: Connections cleaned up, per-player data guarded and server load budgeted from the start — light even in long sessions with full servers.
